title: Double-Slit as Grid-Resolution Phenomenon in Grid-Rendering Cosmology
description: Working note extending Grid-Rendering Cosmology (GRC) to the double-slit experiment with an exact ultraviolet (UV) cutoff formulation arising from a discrete grid scale lg. It derives the deviation from standard QM as an omitted high-k band and shows that for Gaussian slit profiles the deviation is exponentially suppressed, withdrawing a prior polynomial ansatz. The paper relocates testable distinctions to entropy-sensitive decoherence via a clarity function C(S) and to higher-order measurement statistics, noting an open gap in the operational definition of local entropy S.
author: Morten Magnusson

psi_manifest.description: Manifest structure: observable outcomes require the triad of grid geometry G, energy flow E, and clarity C(S).

clarity_function.description: Clarity function linking local entropy S to the sharpness of manifestation; higher S reduces clarity.

registration_distribution.description: Screen registration probability from the net amplitude A(x); reduces to standard QM in the limits C\to 1 and l_g/d \to 0.

mode_amplitude.description: Minimal-model amplitude over grid modes \{\phi_n\} with local entropy-dependent weighting.

uv_cutoff_grc.description: GRC amplitude is band-limited by the grid, implementing an exact UV cutoff at k_{\max}.

uv_cutoff_delta.description: Exact deviation from standard QM as the omitted high-k band beyond the grid cutoff.

gaussian_profile_and_bound.description: For Gaussian slit profiles, the UV-cutoff deviation is exponentially suppressed when \sigma \gg l_g.

key_results.main_finding: In GRC the double-slit deviation from QM is exactly the omitted high-k band due to a grid UV cutoff, yielding exponentially suppressed differences for Gaussian apertures and withdrawing the prior O((l_g/d)^2) polynomial ansatz.

sealed_predictions.statement: Continuum recovery: In the double limit C(S) \to 1 and l_g/d \to 0, the GRC registration distribution P(x) reproduces the standard QM double-slit interference pattern.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: High-visibility double-slit experiments with wide slits and negligible entropy injection that systematically deviate from standard QM beyond experimental systematics.

sealed_predictions.statement: Entropy-sensitive decoherence: Interference visibility is suppressed in proportion to local entropy increase near a slit via C(S) = exp(-S/S_max), even when no which-path information is recorded.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Controlled entropy injection (e.g., engineered thermal/phonon load) at a slit without path information leakage that yields no measurable visibility change relative to a no-entropy-injection control.

sealed_predictions.statement: Higher-order statistics: Under controlled S histories, higher-order detection statistics (e.g., second-order correlations/cumulants) exhibit departures from standard QM predictions tied to C(S), beyond mean-intensity fringe visibility changes.
sealed_predictions.falsifiable_by: Single-photon (or single-particle) double-slit with multiplexed detectors measuring higher-order correlations showing no S-dependent deviation from standard QM across varied entropy loads.

kill_criteria: KC1: Entropy-neutral which-path couplings that preserve local S while fully destroying interference would contradict the claim that S (via C(S)) mediates decoherence.

KC2: Controlled local entropy injection at a slit (verifiably without which-path information leakage) that fails to reduce visibility in the direction and scale predicted by C(S) = exp(-S/S_max) would falsify P3.

KC3: Aperture-profile tomography using Gaussian slits across \sigma values that cannot be fit by the GRC band-limited model with k_max = \pi/l_g for any physically plausible l_g (i.e., residuals incompatible with the predicted exponential suppression) would falsify the UV-cutoff mechanism.

KC4: Demonstration of robust sub-grid spatial registration (effective localization) well below any finite l_g across multiple platforms without concomitant decoherence would force l_g \to 0, contradicting the discrete-grid postulate A1/A5.

KC5: Observation of leading polynomial-in-(l_g/d) deviations in fringe patterns across geometries where GRC predicts exponential suppression for Gaussian profiles would refute the revised prediction and the UV-cutoff derivation.
subtitle: Ontological Extension, UV-Cutoff Analysis, and Open Gaps toward Quantum Testability
scope: Ontological and minimal-model extension of GRC to sub-L0 quantum regime. Not an empirical closure paper.
abstract: GRC treats quantum uncertainty as grid-resolution: Delta x >= l_g. UV-cutoff derivation shows geometric deviation from QM is exponentially suppressed: |Delta A| ~ exp(-pi^2 sigma^2 / 2 l_g^2). Primary testable distinction relocated to entropy-sensitive decoherence (P3) and higher-order measurement statistics (P4). Polynomial ansatz O((l_g/d)^2) withdrawn.

manifest_triad.G: Discrete geometric substrate with node scale l_g

axioms.name: Grid (G)
axioms.content: Discrete geometric substrate with fundamental node scale l_g

axioms.name: Energy Flow (E)
axioms.content: Energy manifests as distributed flow through G; localized = particle-like, distributed = field-like

axioms.name: Clarity Function C(S)
axioms.content: C(S) = exp(-S/S_max); low S = high clarity, high S = low clarity

axioms.name: Manifest Structure
axioms.content: Psi_manifest = G(x) ⊗ E(x,t) · C(S(x,t)); no registration without triad

axioms.name: Grid-Resolution Limit
axioms.content: Spatial registration limited by l_g; position cannot be realized below l_g

axioms.name: Registration as Local Selection
axioms.content: Measurement = physical process that locally selects and stabilizes Psi_manifest

definitions.name: Geometry as boundary condition
definitions.content: Double-slit = boundary condition selecting subset of allowed grid modes

definitions.name: Interference as distributed grid-coupling
definitions.content: High C(S) maintains distributed coupling; P(x) = weighted distribution over allowed positions

definitions.name: Registration as local selection
definitions.content: Distributed manifest structure selected and stabilized as local event

definitions.name: Measurement as entropic localization
definitions.content: Which-path measurement increases S locally, lowers C(S), reduces distributed coupling

definitions.name: Scale limit
definitions.content: At d ~ l_g, continuous approximation breaks; possible QM distinction

minimal_model.M1: Grid-mode basis {phi_n(x)} with resolution l_g; recovers QM as l_g -> 0
minimal_model.M2: Amplitude: A(x) = sum_n a_n phi_n(x) C(S_n)
minimal_model.M3: Registration: P(x) = |A(x)|^2; recovers QM in double limit C->1, l_g/d->0
minimal_model.M4: Decoherence: local S-increase suppresses cross-terms in |A(x)|^2
minimal_model.M5_revised: UV cutoff: Delta A = integral[|k|>pi/l_g] a-tilde(k) e^{ikx} dk

uv_cutoff.grc_amplitude: A_GRC(x) = integral[-kmax,kmax] a-tilde(k) e^{ikx} dk, kmax = pi/l_g
uv_cutoff.exact_deviation: Delta A(x) = integral[|k|>pi/l_g] a-tilde(k) e^{ikx} dk
uv_cutoff.gaussian_bound: |Delta A| <= (l_g / pi sigma^2) exp(-pi^2 sigma^2 / 2 l_g^2)
uv_cutoff.conclusion: Exponentially suppressed for sigma >> l_g; polynomial ansatz O((l_g/d)^2) withdrawn
uv_cutoff.practical_implication: For sub-Planckian l_g, deviation is numerically indistinguishable from zero

predictions.name: Backward compatibility
predictions.content: Must recover standard QM as C->1 and l_g/d->0

predictions.name: Geometric cutoff deviation
predictions.content: UV-cutoff deviation is exponentially suppressed; principled but inaccessible for sub-Planckian l_g

predictions.name: S-sensitive decoherence
predictions.content: Decoherence modulated by local S via tau_d proportional to C(S); distinct from standard Lindblad if S definable independently of T

predictions.name: Gradual which-path suppression
predictions.content: Partial S-increase produces gradual interference suppression; distinguishable via higher-order statistics

predictions.name: No prediction for d >> l_g
predictions.content: GRC makes no deviation prediction when d >> l_g and S is low

falsification_points.condition: No scale-deviation where GRC predicts one
falsification_points.note: Principled, not operative for sub-Planckian l_g

falsification_points.condition: Decoherence fully reduced to T + environment with no S-component
Higher-order statistics identical to QM under partial measurement
Delta P(x) doesn't decrease with d/l_g in UV-cutoff model
Standard QM results at d >> l_g do NOT falsify GRC

candidates.assessment: Weakest; likely reduces to standard QM

candidates.name: Entanglement entropy against environment
candidates.assessment: Requires showing C(S_B) predicts different rate than Lindblad

open_gaps.success_criterion: Produces (1) distinct proxy not reducible to T, (2) different functional form, (3) different dependence, or (4) different statistical signature

one_line_status: Geometric cutoff test (P2) inaccessible for sub-Planckian l_g. Quantum distinction, if any, lies in measurement as entropy process (P3/P4), not interference geometry.
